name: SDEF India Scholarship Program 2026-27 (Swami Dayanand Education Foundation)

rules.value: first year full-time UG professional programme in India, 2026-27
rules.quote: Enroll as a first-year full-time undergraduate student in a professional programme in India for 2026–27.
Have secured a minimum of 80% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII

rules.value: JEE Main AIR <= 50,000; JEE Advanced AIR <= 40,000; NEET UG AIR <= 50,000; NATA >= 100

rules.quote: Have an annual family income of ₹12,00,000 or less from all sources.

rules.value: drop/gap year after class XII not eligible; part-time not eligible
rules.quote: Students who have taken a drop/gap year after Class XII.

rules.value: preference to first-generation students and meritorious girls from disadvantaged backgrounds
rules.quote: Preference may be given to first-generation college students.

amount.text: Up to Rs 50,000 per academic year, up to Rs 2,00,000 over four years; 100-150 scholarships a year; paid to college account
amount.quote: Annual Award: Up to ₹50,000 per academic year

documents.name: Entrance scorecard, admission letter, college ID, fee receipt
Utility bill and three photographs of residence
documents.quote: Three photographs of the applicant's residence

deadline.text: Applications open 15 Aug 2026; deadline 31 Oct 2026; notifications mid Nov 2026
